target_customer: Enterprise governance, risk and compliance teams in regulated industries, mainly European
problem: GRC teams manually read regulations, map requirements to controls and policies and track changes across frameworks such as DORA and NIS2.
business_model: B2B SaaS compliance platform, pricing not stated

founders.name: Leo Schuhmann
founders.background_notes: YC page cites a tech and consulting background, no employers listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting obligations from regulatory text and mapping to controls with LLMs is standard, while accuracy and audit-grade traceability are hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: A compliance graph and evidence data create lock-in over time, but the incumbents and many startups offer similar mapping.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents already mapped NIS2 and DORA in 2025 to 2026; adesso became an investor and sales partner in June 2026.

market_need_then: EU regulation such as DORA and NIS2 forced firms to track many obligations; company claims 80 percent less manual work and 50,000 pages processed.

identity.logo: SVG logo in header, design not described
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and concise action headings, tagline 'The world formula for compliance'

brand_strength.rationale: Name is descriptive and memorable but resembles Complyance and Comp AI; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: ComplyDo is an active Berlin company from Fall 2025 with 17 team members and named enterprise logos. In June 2026 adesso invested and agreed a joint sales partnership, a channel advantage. Regulation provides a tailwind, but the market is crowded with larger incumbents.
notes: The adesso press release (16 June 2026) confirms an investment but no amount or stage, so stage is other. Aggregators disagree on totals: Caplight 2.35M with a pre-seed on 2026-05-22, CB Insights 1.8M across three rounds, Stanford TechIndex 2M, FundedIQ 500K in December 2025, tech.eu 1.1M euro; all unverified. Dated competitor sources near the batch were not found (results were 2026 vendor guides), so the list is empty. Team size 17 on YC page versus 8 in another snippet.
